comparison.objective: Pay a cable from a free-turning drum along a marked route, seat its connector, and release it without uncontrolled drum motion; candidate instead adjusts and commissions a rigid robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable task tests bimanual payout, tension and drum-rate management, deformable routing, connector placement, and release. Candidate tests recessed tool alignment, setscrew manipulation, collar micro-rotation, counterholding, torque control, guarded actuation, and iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Cable success requires connector seating, route containment, drum stillness, release, and limits on drum speed and loose coils. Candidate requires physical unlock-adjust-lock and two ≥0.85 J carriage stops without excess stroke, hard-stop contact, rebound, overload, or lock drift. Cable rubric lacks numeric tension and connector-seat force thresholds, but those missing details do not create plausible overlap.
comparison.reason: The cable record evaluates deformable-object constraint keeping and momentum control, whereas the candidate evaluates tool-mediated adjustment, retention, and impact-response commissioning of a rigid mechanism.
